description: Steric clash: PoseBusters 'dock' mode per-pose clash check between docked ligand and receptor (TODO-22 metric #16).
source: PoseBusters 'dock' mode per Buttenschoen, Morris & Deane, Chem. Sci. 2024, 15, 3130-3139, doi:10.1039/D3SC04185A — wraps RDKit + clash-distance checks against the receptor PDB.

value.criteria: PoseBusters 'dock' mode — chemistry + protein-ligand clash checks per docked pose

notes: PoseBusters 'dock' mode requires the per-pose docked.pdbqt + the receptor PDB + RDKit + clash-distance checks. RDKit and posebusters are not installed in this snapshot, so per-pose clash checks cannot be computed at this time.
Existing PB pass-rate measurements on this pocket exist in the 'mol' mode (chemistry-only, no protein) at molmetal/metrics/by_metric/pb_pass_rate.json — that mode does NOT include steric clash.

Wired-in path: molmetal/molmetal_lam/sbdd_env/posebusters_adapter.py — PoseBustersAdapter.dock(receptor_pdb, docked_pdbqt) returns a PBResult with the clash check. When RDKit/posebusters are available, the recompute is:
clash_pass_rate = sum(r.passed for r in results) / len(results)
Not measured on 1h36 / test_001..test_019 because the staged receptors are missing in this snapshot.
deferred_detail: RDKit + posebusters Python packages not installed in this snapshot; per-pose steric clash check cannot run. Existing 'mol'-mode PB pass rate is at molmetal/metrics/by_metric/pb_pass_rate.json and does not include the dock-mode clash check.
